policy: The authoritative Saudi geographic hub is /service-areas, titled "سايتوتك في السعودية". City pages are allowed only when they add genuinely distinct healthcare-access context such as travel, pilgrimage, distance to care, or regional referral planning. No city page may include sales, prices, delivery, providers, fake reviews, or unsafe dosing instructions.
